TV 0.130 and Token-DiFR gap 0.455 also match system-prompted (0.108-0.144 and 0.28-0.52), while fine-tuned TV tops out at 0.099 and DiFR at 0.31. KL of 0.490 exceeds every category's range, which points to a large shift and favors system-prompted over fine-tuned or quantized. Quantized is ruled out by the much lower agreement and larger divergences. Base is ruled out because all values are non-zero. Fine-tuned remains the main alternative.
